title: docs(spec,qa): OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE ledger comment and manifest-install-contract acceptance[1] name when migrateCommand is absent
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbTGhxJSYAmQXU7efVdNqrpw)_

Fixes #33618

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两处文字，不动代码。错误码台账里 `OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE` 那一行的注释，以及测试清单 `platform-core.manifest-install-contract` 的 acceptance[1](rev 10 → 11)。两处都改为与已发布的拒绝一致：迁移命令只在迁移下限(16)到运行时主版本之间给出，低于下限或高于运行时都不给。
- 为什么改:#33466 已让低于下限的包不再收到注定失败的 `migrate meta --from N`,但这两处文字仍写着"总会给迁移命令",照着读的 agent 和 QA 会得出错误预期。
- 风险与回滚：只是注释和 QA 清单文字，运行行为不变;spec 的 `*.zod.ts` 随包发布，所以带一个 patch changeset。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:① `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts` 的 `OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE` 注释;② `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json` 该项 acceptance[1] 与新增 history 行;③ changeset。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`,预期退出码 0 且打印 OK。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`, the comment on the `OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE` row.** The comment said the remedy is `objectstack migrate meta --from N`, and listed `migrateCommand` among the `error.details` members unconditionally. It now states the shipped shape, read from `checkProtocolCompat` (`packages/metadata-core/src/protocol-handshake.ts`) at base `895783a1e8`:
  - `requiredRange`, `rangeSource`, `protocolVersion` and `targetMajor` are on every refusal.
  - `migrateCommand` is `objectstack migrate meta --from N` for a target major from the support floor up to the runtime's. The floor is `MIGRATE_META_SUPPORT_FLOOR` = 16, which a test holds equal to the spec's `MIGRATION_SUPPORT_FLOOR`.
  - `migrateCommand` is the bare `objectstack migrate meta` when the target major is null.
  - It is absent when the target is AHEAD of the runtime (#26480) or BELOW the floor (#33466). In both cases the message names the remedies that apply.

  This is a line comment, not a `.describe()`, so no generator reads it. The row and the code are unchanged.
- **`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`, item `platform-core.manifest-install-contract`.**
  - acceptance[1] now scopes `migrateCommand` to the floor. At or above the floor and at or below the runtime, the refusal carries `--from TARGET`. Below the floor, it carries none, and the message names a build for this runtime's protocol, or reaching protocol 16 by another path and then `--from 16`. The clause also says every refusal carries `targetMajor`.
  - Revision 10 → 11, with a history row citing #33618.
  - The steps, the verify text and the other clauses are unchanged. On an 18 runtime the `^(RT-1)` probe targets 17, which is above the floor.
- **`.changeset/33618-protocol-incompatible-ledger-comment.md`**: a `@objectstack/spec` patch. `src/**/*.zod.ts` is in the spec's `files[]`, so the comment ships.

## Tests

No behaviour changed, so there is no new test and no ablation. Both diffs are text, and os-dev.md does not ablate docs or comments.

- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`: exit 0, `OK — 16 areas, 429 items`.
- A semantic diff parsed `platform-core.json` at origin/main and at HEAD. Item order is unchanged (47 items). Only `platform-core.manifest-install-contract` differs, and only in `acceptance` (index 1 alone), `revision` (10 → 11) and `history` (10 → 11 rows).

## Acceptance notes

- **Overlap with #33931.** #33931 (#33860) edited a different item in the same area file, `platform-core.bare-name-one-holder-refusal`. Neither path is routed to a merge driver (`git check-attr merge` answers `unspecified` for both), so `git merge-tree` gives the textual answer. Before #33931 merged, both runs exited 0 and printed only the tree id, with no conflicted path:

  ```text
  git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only 1ca1a700b3 d6f080e8c3   (#33931 head; merge base 895783a1e8)
  3616dbc86b76d2e05519e3b4eafcbd695af3a4cf
  EXIT=0
  git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only 1ca1a700b3 895783a1e8   (origin/main then)
  780e88ea94c010221cc127a9112c6cf67c1a6d9e
  EXIT=0
  ```

  #33931 then landed on main as de905ccd7e. This branch merged origin/main at 03b4d2d1f4 without conflict (head dcda950ef9). A semantic diff against main still shows only `manifest-install-contract` changed: acceptance[1], revision 10 → 11, and one more history row. `git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only HEAD origin/main` at a3aa1d29a3 also exits 0.
- `docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md` still teaches the old shape in three places. These are reported to the skills carrier, not edited here:
  - Line 116 (D1): "the exact replay command (`objectstack migrate meta --from N`, D3)".
  - Line 191: "`objectstack migrate meta --from 10` composes the steps".
  - Line 536: "`migrate meta --from 10` therefore reaches protocol 15".

  With the floor at 16, the CLI refuses `--from 10`.

## Verification

All readings are at head `dcda950ef9`, after the merge of origin/main `03b4d2d1f4`. The spec, formula and lint closure was rebuilt under the verify lock first.

Neither gate reads a source comment or a checklist file. Both are left to CI's Lint and Repo Gates.
</details>

```text
pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test        Test Files 842 passed (842) · Tests 26956 passed | 1 todo   (VERDICT command-exit 0, at 1ca1a700b3)
```
